_about: proto-kitchen (Zafar's rapid prototype, 1 Nov): the eggs station's own data (js/cook/stations/eggs.js; the order is recipes.eggs in data/cook.json). `station`: its name, goal and one line per phase (the grown-ups' '?' box). `words`: the station's own item catalogue (pictures for the helper card); their words are the engine's. `mechanic.levels`: cookMs how long an egg takes to be ready (the ring reaches its green), room how many eggs the pot and the pan each hold (Zafar: room for several), shakers whether the salt and pepper are on the shelf, meal the window's sky at the table (breakfast, lunch or dinner: one setting, the sky changes; Zafar's notes). Sprint 18 wave 2 (s18-g-eggs, 8 Nov): the station reads its art and places from items and scene (Cook.data.settings.eggs); mechanic.levels stays its per-level knobs. S19 wave C: overMs how long a fried egg sits past its full ring before it browns (a look only).
_band: SH-248 (Zafar, 10 Nov): this game's bottom row, read by St.stoneBand(S, {game}); "tray" for top-down things, "shelf" for side-on (docs/game-design/modes/cook-bottom-row.md)

station.name: Eggs
station.verb: Boil or fry, then the plates
station.goal: Each person says how they want their egg. Tap the bowl for an egg, then the pot to boil it or the pan to fry it. When its ring is green, tap it, then tap their plate. Then tap the tray to take it to the table.

phases.eggs: Tap the bowl, then the pot (boiled) or the pan (fried).
phases.plates: When an egg's ring is green, tap it, then tap the plate of the person who asked.
phases.serve: Tap the tray to take it to the table.

kitchen.about: Sprint 18 prep (7 Nov), the settings every kitchen game keeps (STD-F1-03): recipe, scene, items (the art each uses, its size class L/M/S, its engine word), vocab, lines, end, gaps, assets. Added beside the station's own station/words/mechanic keys, which the station reads today and are untouched; wave 2's builder moves the station onto the new keys and deletes the code it copied. Art: block 1 (sources/art/s17-art1/), cut by assets/cook/proto/_cut/s18-prep.cut.json; sizes are the largest drawn size on the 1600x900 stage x1.5, never above the sheet. Words are the engine's ids only: a word or line the engine has no Kutchi for shows as its English in grey italic and is a row in docs/language/recording-sheet.md; `gaps` lists them as of 7 Nov (the engine is the source).

recipe.ref: data/cook.json recipes.eggs (its slots and say-lines live there until wave 2 moves them here)
recipe._levels: As recipes.eggs.slots today (people byLevel 1,2,3,3). cookMs, room, shakers and the meal's sky by level are mechanic.levels (the station reads them now).
